chunks.text: I think the Missing Society is, you know, a society that is, you know, more so focused on personal freedom and happiness.
And, you know, it would cover basic needs, use technology, you know, in a more helpful way.
And, you know, it also help people choose their own path, which I think is, you know, a great idea so people can follow their dreams.
